shortDescription: A framework for magical "entad" items: randomly rolled, rarity-scaled traits on weapons, apparel and furniture that reveal themselves through use, can be bound to a pawn's bloodline, and give durability, moods, abilities, damage effects and building bonuses.
body:
## Generation: point budget (EntadApi, EntadRarityChances.PickWhere)
- Every trait has a generation cost: `points` in XML (cost at its own rarity), else the settings' rarity table (Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 4, Epic 7, Legendary 11). Scaling traits multiply by that table relative to their own rarity (`PointsAt`). Negative = drawback (`IsDrawback`). `points` 0 is a ConfigError. Points are backend only: never on the card, market value unchanged.
- `EntadApplyRequest`: `points` (FloatRange?, null = settings budget 2–6), `maxTraits` (null = settings, 5), `drawbackChance` (0.3), `maxDrawbacks` (1). `traitCount` and the int overloads were removed; `ApplyRandomTraits(thing, float points)` / `GenerateEntadItem(float points)`.
- Loop: pick a (trait, rarity) pair costing ≤ what's left, with the usual rarity and weapon-specific odds; pairs much cheaper than budget-per-remaining-slot are down-weighted ((cost/perSlot)², floor 0.05) so big budgets buy rarer traits. When nothing positive fits, an item allowed drawbacks takes one whose refund buys something, then continues. If no non-drawback trait has been added, the cheapest available trait is taken, so a tiny budget still makes an entad. Stops at the trait cap or when nothing fits.
- Settings: General tab has budget range, trait cap, drawback chance and cap; Rarity tab has the point table.
- Dev "Generate Random Entad Item": settings budget or 1–24 points; message lists each trait, rarity and cost.

## Binding (EntadBinding.cs)
- An entad can be bound to one or more pawns (`CompEntad.Bind`, `EntadApi.Bind/Unbind/GetBoundPawns/TraitsActiveFor`, dev actions). Unbound = traits work for everyone.
- Traits only work and reveal for bound pawns and their descendants (Parent relations, BFS depth 16, cached).
- Gated per user: wearer stats, held-item stats, damage and weapon effects, abilities, equipped hediffs, moods, triggers, meals, reveals, furniture abilities, reloading, persona bonding. Always on: durability, market value, building properties.
- `bindOnFirstUse`. WorldPawnGC keeps bound pawns. UI: inspect "Bound to", info card row, alert.

## Vanilla unique and persona weapons
- No conversion. `EntadUtility.IsUniqueWeapon(def)` (CompUniqueWeapon / CompBladelinkWeapon). Setting `UniqueWeaponChance` (default 0%) gates random traits in the public API; by-name adds and the dev "Apply Random Entad" ignore it.

## Persona weapons (EntadPersona.cs)
- Separate from binding: one pawn, ends at death or destruction, raiders bond too. Uses the pawn's vanilla `equipment.bondedWeapon` slot.
- Entad_Persona (Rare, scales, rolls at random): melee/ranged damage ×1.08, cooldown ×0.8 at Rare. Never on vanilla bladelink defs.
- Reveal: a persona weapon has every trait revealed unless Secretive; Persona/Freewielder/Secretive always named; bond traits stay revealed while bonded. Silent, order-independent (SyncPersonaReveal).
- Patches: EquipmentUtility.CanEquip / AlreadyBondedToWeapon / GetPersonaWeaponConfirmationText / IsBondedTo; Pawn_EquipmentTracker.Notify_EquipmentAdded / Notify_PawnDied; ThoughtWorker_WeaponTraitBonded / KillNeed.CurrentStateInternal.
- Bond effects: `bondedHediffs`, `bondedThought`, `otherWeaponThought`, `killThirstThought` + `killThirstDays`. `neverBond`, `secretive`, `neverRandom`.
- Traits and points: Persona (default 4), Freewielder 1, Secretive -1, Kind Whispers 2, Mad Muttering -2, Gluttonous -1, Jealous -1, Kill Thirst -1.

## Triggers (EntadTriggers.cs)
- Gear events Kill, WakeUp, BillDone, JobDone, TakeDamage, Downed, Eat; furniture Use (Sleep/Eat/Work/Recreation/Other). Effects thought, hediff, heal, rest/food/joy. Queue GameComponent (not saved). `killThought` = Kill trigger. Traits: Last Stand, Mending Rest.

## Weapon effects / Reloadables / Durability / Furniture
- `weaponProperties` (burst count/speed, stopping power), `ignoreAccuracyMaluses`, `equippedHediffs`, `partialStats`.
- Reloadable abilities: `abilityAmmo` etc. Example Stun Charge.
- Durability: MaxHitPoints × setting by highest rarity.
- Furniture moods/abilities via CleanupCurrentJob prefix.

## Localization / Settings / Save compatibility
- Player text keyed `EF_` (plus vanilla Core bladelink keys). Settings tabs General / Rarity and durability / Traits.
- Removed traits map through `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName`; mismatched value lists re-roll alone.

## Open items
- Only persona-bond drawbacks exist so far; general drawbacks would make the drawback setting matter on other items.
- Point values of non-persona traits use the rarity defaults; tune per trait as needed.
- Removing Persona leaves its bond traits doing nothing. Def hot-reload doesn't re-run injectors; kill triggers fire on hunting.
- Palette pins: `Actions\T: <name>`; random action is "Apply Random Entad", generator "Generate Random Entad Item".
